headers.subject: Northwind Robotics: interview with the hiring manager

snippet: Hi Mateo, we would like to invite you to meet Jonas Weber, the hiring manager, on Monday 21 September at 11:00 Monterrey time. Calendar invitation attached.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

We would like to invite you to meet Jonas Weber, the hiring manager for the Robotics Software Engineer role, on Monday 21 September at 11:00 Monterrey time (UTC-6). The conversation takes 60 minutes on video: https://zoom.northwind-robotics.example/j/84420193

The calendar invitation is attached.

Best regards,
Aiko Tanaka
Recruiter, Northwind Robotics
